notes: Cross-verse status split. This chapter fuses several morphemes into one English word fourteen times under rule 30; thirteen are recorded `aligned` and only this one `noncompositional`. EXO.36.19 has the identical construction — מִן + לְ + directional adverb rendered by one English word, מִלְמָעְלָה -> above — recorded `aligned`, and nothing in the source licenses a different status for מִלְּמַטָּה -> beneath. The lemma-keyed table cannot show it, since מַטָּה and מַעַל are different lemmas with one occurrence each. The unit's edges and both heads are unchanged; only the status and its note move.
